scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm exec tsc -b lib/api-client-react/tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @workspace/web typecheck
scripts.build:appwrite: node scripts/prepare-static-dataset.mjs && node scripts/prepare-appwrite-native-deps.mjs && pnpm run validate && node scripts/prepare-appwrite-static.mjs
scripts.validate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build
scripts.validate:ts: node node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js -p lib/api-client-react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && echo TypeScript OK
scripts.map:pipeline: pnpm run export:medicines && pnpm run map:ids
